spots.name: Atigun Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Galbraith Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Toolik Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Toolik Field Station on the shore.

spots.name: Jade Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 923 m (3,028 ft).

spots.name: Toolik Field Station
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 121 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1217734.

spots.name: Chandalar Shelf
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: The Gate of the Arctic on Dalton Highway
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
